topic: Browser test fails after frontend redesign
environment: Frontend deployed with new component library
symptom_pattern: A browser test that clicks 'Add to cart' started failing right after a frontend release with 'element not found', though the button visibly exists in the screenshot.
root_cause: The recorded step relies on a user-specified locator (an id/class that changed in the redesign) instead of the default multi-locator, so it no longer matches the new markup.
resolution_path: Open the failing step's locator settings
Remove the brittle user locator or use a stable data-* attribute, then re-record if needed

qa_pairs.tse_question: Did the failing step have a custom (user specified) locator?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: Yes, someone added #add-to-cart-btn to make it 'more stable'.

qa_pairs.tse_question: Can you check the button's id in the new release?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: It's now a generated class, no id at all.
